svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 09 OF 09 • DOMAIN: 4-REGISTER RPN COMPUTING & EXPRESSION TREES • HARDWARE TACTILE KEYS • DUAL LED BAR GRAPH STACK
LESSON GUIDE: 4-REGISTER RPN STACK & EXPRESSION TREES
Grades 8–16 STEM, AP Physics, Engineering & Mathematics • Hands-On Classroom & Home STEM Studio Series

text.tspan: Stack state: Register Y holds 3.0000; Register X holds 4.0000.
In RPN, numbers always enter before operators!
Press swap [x⇄y]: Register X becomes 3.0000; Y holds 16.0000.
Stack now holds Y = 16.0000 and X = 9.0000.
3. ADD SQUARES: Press [+]. The stack drops: 16.0000 + 9.0000 = 25.0000 in X!

g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: THE FREEDOM FROM PARENTHESES

text.tspan: Evaluating √(3² + 4²) in traditional algebraic mode requires nested parentheses. In RPN,
you calculate from the inside out, exactly as you think! Intermediate numbers sit patiently
on the stack until an operator consumes them. Zero parentheses, zero syntax errors!

g.text: ★ EXTENSION INVESTIGATION: KINETIC ENERGY: E = ½ m v²

text.tspan: Calculate kinetic energy for mass m=12 and velocity v=5: 0.5 [ENTER] 12 [×] 5 [↰] [x²] [×] → 150.0000! Zero parentheses! (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)

g.text: → Assemble with your physical blocks, then scan the QR code to verify with the 3D step-by-step vector model.
